title: Product Stability, Data Consistency & Visible UX

step0_audit.summary: Read-only audit of frontend (8 files: app.js 2549 lines, pipeline.js 1310, tests.js 1373, styles.css 6583, index.html 742) and backend (125 API routes, 4 persistence files). Found: vanilla-JS SPA, atomic writes via atomicWrite.js, debounced saves. Backend APIs all fast (33-150ms). Root cause identified: selectSession had 6 sequential awaits blocking render, SSE opened after all renders.

step1_reload_root_cause.root_cause: selectSession (app.js:74-124) had 6 SEQUENTIAL awaits: loadWorkflows, loadTestCases, loadRegression, loadMetrics, loadPipelineFromSession, loadDevIntelFromSession. loadDevIntelFromSession itself had 8 MORE sequential sub-loads. SSE opened AFTER all renders — live events missed during hydration window. No re-entrancy guard. Only 3/617 sessions had report verdicts persisted.
step1_reload_root_cause.fix: Parallelized 6 loads into Promise.allSettled. Parallelized 8 sub-loads in loadDevIntelFromSession into Promise.allSettled. SSE opens immediately after render (before async loads).
